context: Two friends gossip at the cafe about a celebrity fan
purpose: Teach: ケータイ/オタク/あらかじめ/あきらめ/ものすごく/ビックリ/とりわけ/ひたすら

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ聞いて、昨日ものすごくビックリしたことがあったの。
lines.en: Hey listen, something really shocking happened to me yesterday.
lines.style: Excited gossip tone with rising intonation throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、何々?ケータイで写真とか撮ったの?
lines.en: Huh, what what? Did you take photos with your phone?
lines.style: Curious leaning forward whispered eager voice tone

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それがね、お店に来たお客さん、とりわけ熱心なアイドルオタクだったみたい。
lines.en: So this customer came to the shop, seemed like a really devoted idol fan.
lines.style: Conspiratorial hushed almost giggling delivery throughout sentence

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわぁ、そういう人って、あらかじめグッズ全部揃えてくるよね。
lines.en: Wow, those kinds of people prepare all their merchandise in advance, right.
lines.style: Knowing nostalgic tone with playful teasing edge

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: そうそう、しかもひたすら推しの話ばっかりしてて、こっちは笑いをこらえるの大変だった。
lines.en: Exactly, and they just kept talking nonstop about their favorite, I struggled holding in laughter.
lines.style: Animated storytelling with suppressed laughter bubbling through voice

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あはは、でも途中であきらめずに最後まで聞いてあげたんでしょ?優しい。
lines.en: Haha, but you listened until the end without giving up, didn't you, so sweet.
lines.style: Warm teasing affectionate slightly admiring soft laughing tone

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: まあね、推し活って青春って感じで、ちょっと羨ましかったかも。
lines.en: Well yeah, fan activities feel like youth, I was kind of jealous actually.
lines.style: Reflective softer wistful smile in voice closing remark
